title: Run parallel branches
summary: RunnableParallel sends the same input to named branches and gathers their outputs in a dictionary. Each branch can perform a different local task.
introduction: RunnableParallel sends the same input to named branches and gathers their outputs in a dictionary. Each branch can perform a different local task. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: RunnableParallel sends the same input to named branches and gathers their outputs in a dictionary. Each branch can perform a different local task.

blocks.code:
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableLambda, RunnableParallel
step = RunnableParallel(upper=RunnableLambda(str.upper), length=RunnableLambda(len))
print(step.invoke("Moon"))
blocks.title: Run parallel branches

blocks.text: The result contains upper: MOON and length: 4. Both branches receive the original string Moon, not each other's output.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Parallel branches are not the same as a sequential pipe.
